scope: Repository seed baseline; no deployment database access, migrations, initialization, providers or network requests
reproducibility: Normalized UTF-8/LF source hashes; no wall-clock timestamp; fixed legacy map year explicitly recorded

runtime.reason: The app database accessor initializes/migrates data. It is deliberately not used by this read-only audit. Persisted counts remain null/unknown.

limitations: Source presence is not scholarly review or completion.
Image rights are retained intake metadata, not live URL/license re-verification.
Zero absent-dataset counts are limited to the reviewed seed registry; new source files require adapter reconciliation.
No production/private notes or credentials are read or published.

metrics.label: Catalog/work records
metrics.rule: Distinct work IDs; legacy texts and derived works are the same works, not additive.

metrics.label: Broad tradition groupings
metrics.rule: Distinct navigation grouping IDs; not reviewed community taxonomy.

metrics.label: Source editions
metrics.rule: Distinct edition IDs.

metrics.label: Searchable edition-backed works
metrics.rule: Distinct works with nonempty passages and edition source, license and hash metadata; not certification of primary content or license law.

metrics.label: Complete named-work/edition coverage
metrics.rule: Distinct populated works with edition complete flag; historical study vs named work remains source-specific.

metrics.label: Works without source editions
metrics.rule: No edition association, regardless of decorative metadata.

metrics.label: Edition segments
metrics.rule: Distinct segment IDs; not all segments are primary text.

metrics.label: Explicitly classified primary segments
metrics.rule: Only explicit contentType labels count; edition wording does not establish primary status.

metrics.label: Explicitly classified editorial segments
metrics.rule: Only explicit contentType labels count; edition wording does not establish primary status.

metrics.label: Unclassified/unknown segments
metrics.rule: Segments not explicitly labeled primary or editorial.

metrics.label: Physical witnesses
metrics.rule: Distinct imported and starter witness IDs, independent of works.

metrics.label: Museum artifacts
metrics.rule: Distinct physical object IDs; not additional works or first-class artwork catalog coverage.

metrics.label: Archive image references
metrics.rule: Distinct image IDs; externally hosted references, not downloaded binaries or current URL health certification.

metrics.label: Images with source/rights/attribution
metrics.rule: Recorded public-domain assertion and attribution; not fresh legal review.

metrics.label: Curated relationship records
metrics.rule: Distinct explicit edges; do not infer relationships from similarity.

metrics.label: Works with start dates
metrics.rule: Non-null start date; includes provisional dates.

metrics.label: Works without start dates
metrics.rule: Null start date.

metrics.label: Works with coordinates
metrics.rule: Finite latitude and longitude; presence does not establish geographic precision.

metrics.label: Works without coordinates
metrics.rule: Missing either coordinate.

metrics.label: Map-eligible works through 2026
metrics.rule: Shared map predicate includes undated coordinate-bearing records by default, all traditions; unknown dates are not placed in time.

metrics.label: Timeline-eligible works through 2026
metrics.rule: Current dated-through-year predicate, all traditions.

metrics.label: Works with language metadata
metrics.rule: Language labels only, not original-language transcriptions.
